info.name: Payment Processing System
info.description:
# Payment Processing System API

Bruno OpenCollection aligned with [docs/low-level-design.md](../docs/low-level-design.md).

## Folders

| Folder | Endpoints |
| ------ | --------- |
| `health/` | Actuator health / liveness / readiness / prometheus |
| `user/` | `POST/GET/PATCH /api/v1/users`, list, 404 |
| `transaction/` | Process, get, list, idempotency cases, audit-logs |

## Response envelope

```json
{
  "data": {},
  "message": "...",
  "errors": [],
  "meta": { "requestId": "..." }
}
```

Fraud `DECLINED` / `FLAGGED` are **HTTP 201** success payloads (`data.status`), never `errors[]`.

## How to run

1. `docker compose up --build -d`
2. Open this folder in Bruno → env **Local**
3. `npx @usebruno/cli run --env Local`

request.description:
# GET /actuator/health

Aggregated health of the application.

## When available
Phase 0+

## Success
- **HTTP** `200`
- Body includes `"status": "UP"` when the process and required dependencies are healthy

## Notes
- Liveness = process healthy
- Readiness = PostgreSQL up (required to process payments)
- Mongo down → still READY (async audit only degraded)

# GET /actuator/health/liveness

Process-level liveness probe (Kubernetes-style).

## When available
Phase 0+

## Success
- **HTTP** `200`, `"status": "UP"` while the JVM process is alive

## Failure
- Non-200 when the process should be restarted

# GET /actuator/health/readiness

Readiness probe — app can safely accept payment traffic.

## When available
Phase 0+

## Success
- **HTTP** `200`, `"status": "UP"` when PostgreSQL is reachable

## Failure
- Non-200 / not UP if PostgreSQL is down (do not route payment traffic)

## Design note
MongoDB is **not** required for readiness; audit projection can lag while payments continue.

# POST /api/v1/users

Create a user profile.

## When available
Phase 1+

## Request body

| Field | Required | Notes |
| ----- | -------- | ----- |
| `email` | yes | Unique |
| `kycStatus` | no | Default `PENDING` |

`preApprovedTransactionLimit` starts as `null` (needed later for fraud Rule 1).

## Success
- **HTTP** `201`
- `data` = user resource (`id`, `email`, `kycStatus`, `preApprovedTransactionLimit`, `createdAt`)
- `errors` = `[]`
- `meta.requestId` always set

## Errors
| HTTP | `errors[].code` | When |
| ---- | --------------- | ---- |
| `400` | `VALIDATION_ERROR` | Bad/missing fields (Bean Validation on DTO) |
| `409` | `EMAIL_ALREADY_EXISTS` | Email already exists |

## Side effects
Sets env `userId` for later requests.

# GET /api/v1/users

Cursor-paginated list of users (newest first).

## When available
Phase 1+

## Query params
| Param | Required | Notes |
| ----- | -------- | ----- |
| `cursor` | no | Opaque; from previous `nextCursor` (`{{usersNextCursor}}`) |
| `limit` | no | Default 50, max 200 |
| `kycStatus` | no | `PENDING` \| `VERIFIED` \| `REJECTED` |

## Success
- **HTTP** `200`
- `data.items`, `data.nextCursor`, `data.hasMore`
- Empty page → `items: []`, `hasMore: false`, `nextCursor: null`

## Errors
| HTTP | `errors[].code` |
| ---- | --------------- |
| `400` | `VALIDATION_ERROR` (bad `limit` / `cursor` / `kycStatus`) |

## Prerequisite
Run **Create user** first so the page is non-empty (optional).

# GET /api/v1/users/{id}

Fetch a user profile by id.

## When available
Phase 1+

## Path params
| Param | Source |
| ----- | ------ |
| `id` | `{{userId}}` (from Create user) |

## Success
- **HTTP** `200`
- `data` = user resource
- `errors` = `[]`

## Errors
| HTTP | `errors[].code` |
| ---- | --------------- |
| `404` | `USER_NOT_FOUND` or `NOT_FOUND` |

## Prerequisite
Run **Create user** first (or set `userId` in Local env).

# PATCH /api/v1/users/{id}

Partial update of KYC status and/or `preApprovedTransactionLimit`.

## When available
Phase 1+

## Request body (any subset)
| Field | Notes |
| ----- | ----- |
| `kycStatus` | e.g. `PENDING`, `VERIFIED`, … |
| `preApprovedTransactionLimit` | Raised by ops after offline approval; Rule 1 uses this |

## Success
- **HTTP** `200`
- `data` = updated user

## Errors
| HTTP | `errors[].code` |
| ---- | --------------- |
| `404` | `USER_NOT_FOUND` / `NOT_FOUND` |
| `400` | `VALIDATION_ERROR` (e.g. limit ≤ 0) |

## Why this matters
A limit of `15000` allows a `12000` payment that would otherwise be DECLINED by Rule 1.

# GET /api/v1/users/{id} — not found

Negative test: unknown UUID returns 404 envelope (not an empty 200).

## When available
Phase 1+

## Expected
- **HTTP** `404`
- `data` = `null`
- `errors[]` with `USER_NOT_FOUND` or `NOT_FOUND`
- `meta.requestId` present

request.description:
# POST /api/v1/transactions

Process a payment: lock user row → velocity + fraud → persist transaction + audit outbox → respond.

## When available
Phase 3+

## Headers
| Header | Required | Notes |
| ------ | -------- | ----- |
| `Idempotency-Key` | no | Replay-safe; same key + same fingerprint → original txn |

## Request body
| Field | Required | Notes |
| ----- | -------- | ----- |
| `amount` | yes | > 0 |
| `userId` | yes | Existing user UUID |
| `merchantId` | yes | Merchant identifier |
| `category` | yes | e.g. `ELECTRONICS` |

## Success (all business outcomes)
- **HTTP** `201 Created`
- `data.status` ∈ `APPROVED` \| `FLAGGED` \| `DECLINED`
- `errors` = `[]`

## Errors
| HTTP | `errors[].code` | When |
| ---- | --------------- | ---- |
| `404` | `USER_NOT_FOUND` | Unknown user |
| `409` | `IDEMPOTENCY_CONFLICT` | Same key, different fingerprint |
| `400` | `VALIDATION_ERROR` | Malformed body |
| `503` | `SERVICE_UNAVAILABLE` | PostgreSQL / commit failure |

## Side effects
Sets env `transactionId` and (if empty) `idempotencyKey`.
